protocol.title: Options implied-volatility term structure (near-dated minus far-dated near-ATM IV slope) -> forward realized-vol predictiveness: a distinct-surface-signal wrapper-free rank information coefficient falsification on the real on-disk three-way captures
protocol.extends: EVAL-71 (identical Spearman rank-IC statistic, forward-rv target and causal expanding-zscore) but a DIFFERENT, distinct surface signal: the cross-expiry term-structure SLOPE (near-minus-far ATM IV), not the near-ATM level/skew EVAL-71 already sealed; no new acquisition
protocol.supersedes: nothing -- this is the term-structure complement to EVAL-71's level/skew surface signal; it does not re-litigate EVAL-71 (level/skew), EVAL-72 (straddle monetization) or EVAL-73 (temporal stability)
protocol.signal: causal per-bar implied-vol term structure from the real Deribit option trade tape: near-ATM trades grouped by expiry; term_slope = IV(near expiry) - IV(far expiry) (vol points), term_ratio = IV(near)/IV(far) - 1; near = earliest and far = latest expiry each with >= min_expiry_trades near-ATM trades in the trailing window; both forward-filled then expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target: rv = sqrt(mean(log-return^2)) over the next H perp bars (forward realized vol, strictly after the decision at k)
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(signal_z_k, rv_forward_k); directional permutation H1: IC>0 (a steeper/higher near-minus-far IV slope predicts higher forward realized vol)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS) -- the term-structure slope does not add portable forward-vol predictiveness beyond EVAL-71's level/skew.
